P.name: Dirty Fighting
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Akshan''' uses a {{tip|basic attack}}, he fires an additional shot after a delay that deals {{as|50% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, increased to {{as|100% AD}} against {{tip|minions}}. Issuing an {{tt|attack order|Default right-click/MB2}} on a different target before the additional shot has been launched causes '''Akshan''' to fire it at the new target. If the second shot is cancelled instead, he gains {{as|{{pplevel|20 to 75}}|ms}} {{times}} {{as|(1 + 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 1 second.
P.description2: The additional shot applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Akshan's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability}} hits apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Dirty Fighting'' to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal them {{as|{{pp|15;40;80;150|1;6;11;16}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}; if the target is a {{tip|champion}}, '''Akshan''' will also gain a {{pplevel|40+(240/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} {{as|(+ 35% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds. The shield may be gained only once every few seconds.

Q.name: Avengerang
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' throws a boomerang in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 1 second and extending its range each time it hits a target. If this hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, '''Akshan''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|20%|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} that decays over 1 second.
Q.description2: Once the boomerang has passed its original range and has not hit a target in the last 500 units of travelling, it homes back to '''Akshan''' and applies the same effects to enemies hit.
Q.description4: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

W.name: Going Rogue
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Akshan''' marks enemy {{tip|champions}} that kill allied champions as ''Scoundrels'' for 60 seconds. If '''Akshan''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against a ''Scoundrel'' while alive and within 3 seconds of damaging them, he receives an additional {{g|100}} and resurrects all {{tip|death|dead}} allied champions that they have slain after 1 second.
W.description2: When '''Akshan''' claims a ''Scoundrel's'' bounty he removes the marks of all other enemies. ''Scoundrels'' refresh their mark duration on subsequent kills, and will have their mark removed when they die by any means. '''Akshan''' cannot mark enemies as ''Scoundrels'' while they are dead. Allies are resurrected at their [[Spawn|summoning platform]].
W.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' enters {{tip|camouflage}}, which lasts indefinitely while he is near [[terrain]] or inside {{tip|brush}}, and for 2 seconds otherwise. During this time, he can see trails leading toward ''Scoundrels'', and while facing them if they are within {{tt|5000|Pending for test}} units, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' mana regeneration}}}} equal to {{as|12% of his '''missing''' mana}} as well as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
W.description4: ''Going Rogue'' can be recast after 1 second, and does so automatically after its duration. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Going Rogue'' immediately.
W.description5: '''''Akshan''' can move during Going Rogue's cast time.''

E.name: Heroic Swing
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' can activate ''Heroic Swing'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, and can use the third cast only after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the second cast. '''Akshan''' may input an attack or movement command to use the second and third casts.
E.description2: {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Akshan''' fires a hook in the target direction that embeds in the first [[terrain]] hit, and enters {{tt|preparation|See notes}} for up to {{fd|2.125}} seconds. ''Heroic Swing's'' second cast can be used while the hook is attached. If the hook fails to attach or '''Akshan''' is {{tt|moved|See notes}} or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}} within the duration, the preparation will end prematurely, cancelling ''Heroic Swing'' in the process.
E.description3:
{{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Akshan''' {{tip|dash|swings}} around the terrain in either a clockwise or counterclockwise direction based on the position of the cursor relative to his {{tt|facing direction|See notes}}, stopping upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain. While swinging, he fires at the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy every {{rutngt|0.2}} to deal them {{as|physical damage}} and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects for each shot, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness.

'''''Akshan''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash.''
E.leveling3: {{st|Physical Damage per Shot|{{ap|8 to 40}} {{as|(+ 25% AD)}} {{times}} {{as|(1 + {{fd|0.3}} per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)}}}}
E.description4: {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Akshan''' ends the swing by {{tip|dash|jumping}} to the target location, though not through terrain, and fires one last shot at a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy.
E.description5: Scoring an enemy champion {{tip|takedown}} reduces ''Heroic Swing's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} to {{fd|0.5}} seconds. The shots can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage|{{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}}}and {{tip|applies life steal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
E.description6: ''{{ai|Avengerang|Akshan}} and {{ai|Going Rogue|Akshan}} can be cast during the third cast's dash. {{ai|Comeuppance|Akshan}} can be cast at all points during Heroic Swing, though '''Akshan''' cannot fire during the swing while it is active. '''Akshan''' prioritizes firing at enemy champions with stacks of {{ai|Dirty Fighting|Akshan}}, then those damaged by his {{tip|unit-targeted|targeted}} spells in the last 4 seconds, then the nearest enemy. Heroic Swing can be cast during '''Akshan's''' other abilities.''

R.name: Comeuppance
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Akshan''' locks onto the target enemy champion and begins {{tip|channel|channeling}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them as well as {{tip|sight|revealing}} himself. He gradually stores bullets into his weapon over the duration.
R.leveling:
{{st|Maximum Bullets Stored|{{ap|5 to 7}}}}
{{st|Bullet Storing Interval Time|{{ap|2.5/4 to 2.5/6|round=4}} seconds}}
R.description2: ''Comeuppance'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically afterwards. ''Comeuppance'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|5-second}} cooldown if the channel is cancelled.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Akshan''' fires all stored bullets at the target, each briefly granting {{tip|sight}} around their trajectory and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 30|critScaling=true}}, as well as by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 200 for 11|0 to 100|formula=2% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}}. The shots can hit {{tip|structures}}.
R.leveling3:
<!--
-->{{st|Minimum Physical Damage per Bullet|{{ap|25 to 45}} {{as|(+ 15% AD)}}<!--
-->|Maximum Physical Damage per Bullet|{{ap|25*3 to 45*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*3}}% AD)}}<!--
-->|Minimum Charged Physical Damage|{{ap|5*25|6*35|7*45}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15*5 to 15*7}}% AD)}}<!--
-->|Damage to target on 67% missing hp|{{ap|3*5*25|3*6*35|3*7*45}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3*5*15 to 3*7*15}}% AD)}}<!--
-->}}
R.description4: Each bullet's damage {{tip|applies life steal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|execute|executes}} {{tip|minions}}.
